name: Frieden
beschreibung:
Perched high above the Inn Valley, Hotel Frieden on Hochpillberg serves as a serene sanctuary for rest and relaxation. Guests enjoy generous sunshine, pine-scented hiking trails, and fresh alpine breezes in the Karwendel Silver Region.

The Kellerjoch lift and diverse mountain trails through the Tux and Karwendel ranges are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Frieden on Hochpillberg offers idyllic tranquility and sweeping panoramic views across the Inn Valley.
